records.title: National Waterway-5
details: a to c: Based on the outcome of the DPR, the project for development of NW-5 from Talcher to Paradip/Dhamra is under consideration, and the work will be taken up after formal approval of the project.

records.title: CONSTRUCTION OF NEW RAILWAY LINE IN ODISHA
details: a to e: As on 01.04.2024, 40 Projects (13 New Lines, 1 Gauge Conversion and 26 Doubling) of total length 4,017 Km, costing Rs. 54,434 crore, falling fully/partly in Odisha are in planning/approval/construction stage, out of which, 1,100 Km length has been commissioned and an expenditure of Rs. 22,833 crore has been incurred upto March, 2024

records.title: Work On National Waterway No. 5
details: (a) & (c): The project for evacuation of coal from coal mines near Talcher and connectivity of Industrial area at Kalinganagar with Ports of Dhamra and Paradip on NW-5 has been conceptualized.
